items.title: William Russell Interview, 1976-02-16
items.q: it isn't one of my favorite hardly a typical rough style New Orleans band like Peter Boccage for instance... Peter played some nice jazz at times too. In the late years he played a very nice trumpet in which I never saw him read in my life.

ctx.x: probably plenty of old rough players but they weren't probably the best and they probably didn't know too many tunes. But to play a large number of rags you probably had to be didn't have to be but most of them were. So I think as I say the only thing we can judge from now since we weren't around in the 1900s early 1900s to hear the music down here or any place else. one thing we have to go by are the records and if you listen to the eastern bands the things that they recorded compared to the New Orleans bands in…
